snippet.title: Sundered Soul Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Sundered Soul: Chains of the Undying is a fast-paced 2D Rogue-Lite with twin-stick shooter controls. Every run demands skill, strategy, and quick reflexes. Take on Story Mode, survive the Arena, or hunt Champions for powerful relics. Collect and combine relics as you fight to break an eternal curse.
